kicad_drc.install: sudo add-apt-repository ppa:kicad/kicad-9.0-releases && sudo apt install kicad (or your distribution's kicad package, version 9 or newer)

skipped.why: KiCad or Java is not installed: routed with the built-in router
skipped.how: install them for FreeRouting (docs/setup.md); dense 0.4 mm pitch chips need it

critic.text: via GND at (2.75, 19.42) is 0.16 mm from C1.2 (keep 0.2 mm of track between them)
critic.hint: move the via off the pad, or route a short neck to it
critic.why: A via right against a pad of its own net drinks the pad's solder in reflow: the joint starves and a small part can tombstone. A short neck of track between them keeps the solder on the pad.
